overall: The set is mostly clean. The checker passes 348/348, holiday leakage is rare, and most items are school-level facts a 2B model should know. Main problems: (1) a few concept leaks: Valentino 'red' (the holiday colour), XOXO for ' hug' (love-note sign-off, and which letter is the hug is disputed), and a bare チョコ translation (Japanese Valentine chocolate), which is inconsistent with how namorados/情人 were treated. (2) Giveaways: BWV naming Bach, 'Loving v. Virginia' answering 'which country', Guns N' Roses echoing Axl Rose, a male option for 'which woman', the parenthetical 'Rotation (torque)', and 'Plaisir d'amour' as the only love-titled option. (4) A few items where the token is decorative (' Valent' Borgia, Valentinian III/Attila) or the wording is forced ('Gregorian Calendar', 'Grooved rifling', 'cherry blossom floral season'). A minor pattern of hedged 'X only' distractors is worth cleaning up. Classes: 'Coup' is wrongly left at 0 items (quoted 'Coup d'état'/'Coup de grace'/'Couples' all give the token), and 'Valentin' (0 items) should be reclassified as exclusive.
